Forgot Password Screens UI Development [Pre Dev]
column31:
*User Story: Forgot Password Flow Development*

As a user of the Connexus application, I want to reset my password through a seamless forgot password flow, so that I can regain access to my account if I forget my password.

*Acceptance Criteria:*

# *First Screen: Email Entry*
#* A text field to enter the user's email address
#* A "Continue" button
# *Second Screen: Message Box*
#* A message box that displays either a success message ("Message sent successfully") or an error message
#* A button to redirect the user to the login page
# *Third Screen: Reset Password*
#* Two text fields:
#** "Enter New Password"
#** "Re-enter New Password"
#* A "Submit" button

The design and flow should be consistent with the latest Figma specifications to ensure a smooth and user-friendly experience.

column1: Login page UI Development [Pre Dev]
column31:
*User Story: Login Screen UI Development*

As a user of the Connexus application, I want to access a login screen that aligns with the latest Figma design, so that I can securely log in with my email and password.

*Acceptance Criteria:*

# The login screen should include:
#* Email input field
#* Password input field
#* Login button positioned below the password field
# Below the password field:
#* A "Remember Me" checkbox on the left side
#* A "Forgot Password" hyperlink on the right side
# The left panel of the login screen should feature:
#* Connexus logo
#* Background design
#* A button leading to the "Get in Touch" page

The design should be consistent with the latest Figma specifications to ensure a seamless and visually appealing user experience.

column1: Home Page with navigation and coming-soon [Pre Dev]
column31:
*User Story: Home Page Post-Login Experience*

As a user of the Connexus application, I want to access the home page after a successful login, so that I can see upcoming features and navigate through the application.

*Acceptance Criteria:*

# Upon successful login, the user is redirected to the home page.
# The home page displays a "Coming Soon" picture.
# A side navigation menu is available with the following features:
#* Menu items with collapsible expand options
#* At the bottom of the navigation menu, the user's profile icon and email are displayed.
#* A "Sign Out" option is available in the profile section.

The design should be intuitive and align with the latest Figma specifications to provide a cohesive user experience.

column1: Get in touch page UI Development  [Pre Dev]
column31:
*User Story: Get in Touch Page Development*

As a user of the Connexus application, I want to access a "Get in Touch" page that includes all necessary fields to contact the company, so that I can provide detailed information and send my message.

*Acceptance Criteria:*

# The "Get in Touch" page should include the following fields, all of which are mandatory except for "Company Website" and "Unit Count":
#* Name
#* Company Name
#* Title
#* Email
#* Phone Number (with country code)
#* City
#* State
#* Company Website (optional)
#* Unit Count (optional)
#* Message
# The page should also have two buttons:
#* "Send Message"
#* "Close"

The design should be user-friendly and ensure that all mandatory fields are clearly indicated to facilitate easy and accurate information submission.

+*Acceptance Criteria*+

*Role Management Browse page -Client*

# User can navigate to Role management page by clicking on Role management option in side nav bar.

# All Roles should be classified to *Connexus Team/client/Vendor* user type. 
# User should able to navigate to client tab by clicking on client tab

# if there is no organization is selected,it should show blank screen which show the message as “*Please select any organization from the dropdown“* 
# User should able to select any organization from the dropdown and should list all the created roles under the organization 
# System defaulted roles like admin, manager and users  should be non deletable and non-aditable from the system
# Page name should be *Roles*  and should display a Create Role button at the right hand corner of the screen 
# Role list page should display all the roles created in the system with pagination 
# Role list page should have column headers as organization nameRole name ,Permission,Associated users and icons like edit and delete button 
# Search button should be available in the role list page and search functionality should be working for all the role names under each tab. Eg: if the user search for a role name in 2nd page under user tab it should display the search result whereas if the user search for a rolename of client user type under user tab,it should show no result found. 
# user should able to edit the role by clicking on edit icon present across each record 
# Associated user column should be added in the browse page
# user should able to delete the created Role name. before deleting it should check whether any associated users are linked to the role name, if there is any associated users is available(ie,associated user count is greater than 0) then it should show alert message as “*This role cannot be deleted because there are users associated with it.“*
# if the associated user count is zero then it should not ask for the above message and user should able to delete the Role name with confirming message *“Are you sure you want to delete the Role ?  “ with Ok and Cancel button*
# Bulk delete functionality should be available in the list page

column31:
+*Accetance Criteria:*+

*As a*n Admin of the connexus application
*I want* to view,create or Edit a list of all users
*So that* I can manage their roles, statuses, and other details.

* Admin will be added to the system by Neoito team by adding their registered  Email id  in to the usermanagement system with full access role. 

      Users to be added to the system as Admin : 

      *Name :* Heather 

      *Email* : [heather@joinconnexus.com|mailto:heather@joinconnexus.com] 

     *Name :* Devin

    *Email*: [devin@joinconnexus.com|mailto:devin@joinconnexus.com] 
Add one of them as Super Admin(    *Name :* Devin  *Email*: [devin@joinconnexus.com|mailto:devin@joinconnexus.com] )

*Contact  Management Browse Page:* 

* The contact management list page should display all the users 
* Each user should be displayed as a row in the table.
* List page should have column headers as Name,email address,Roles,Status. 
* The list should include users of all types: Connexus team, Client, and Vendor and display as tabs.
* By default connexus team should be selected and it should display all the connexus staff
* There should be a filter option with filter parameters are *status*,*Role name,**_Authorized user_*
* The page should display a pagination control at the bottom, allowing navigation through the user list.
* There should be a search bar to search users by name or email address.
* There should be a three dot button for each record which open the actions items to be performed on the contact managmeent list 
*  Three dot options should be Edit,Delete,Resent,Deactivate,Authorize user,profile details
* Status should be displayed as pending,active,Inactive.Status color code as Active -green color , Inactive -red color ,pending -blue color 
* if user clicks on inactive user more options icon , only active option should be there. 

FIgma: 

[https://www.figma.com/design/HuFqPOMscB9vnvKq6nqyc9/Internal---Connexus-Design-System?node-id=8-155187&t=sA0jLotN4YKaRSra-4|https://www.figma.com/design/HuFqPOMscB9vnvKq6nqyc9/Internal---Connexus-Design-System?node-id=8-155187&t=sA0jLotN4YKaRSra-4|smart-link] 



*Contact Management Create Page:* 

* There should be a "Create" button on the contact management list page.
* Create button should be a dropdown with user type values as connexus team,Client,Vendor
* Clicking the "Create" button should open a form to enter the new user's details.
* The form should include fields for First name ,last name, email address, phone number ,role, and status and user type
* There should be a "Create" button to save the new user and a "Cancel" button to discard the creation.
* Email address field should be unique
* Name field should accept only alphabets and it should not allow any numbers or special characters 
* Email fileld validation should be added for invalid emaild format or already existing emailids
* Roles should be a dropdown and it should list all the roles created for the selected user type.
* Roles field should be a multi select field 
* Authorize user value by default will be no and user can change the value to yes to grant the access to the client.
* Name field should be unique 
* Upon clicking on create , the new user should appear in the user management list.
* Email should be sent to the entered registered email with ocnfirmation message as email sent successfully
* Status of the created user should be pending and it should change to active when user clicks on the link from the email and once the password reset done by user  

FIgma: 
[https://www.figma.com/design/HuFqPOMscB9vnvKq6nqyc9/Internal---Connexus-Design-System?node-id=114-244877&t=sA0jLotN4YKaRSra-4|https://www.figma.com/design/HuFqPOMscB9vnvKq6nqyc9/Internal---Connexus-Design-System?node-id=114-244877&t=sA0jLotN4YKaRSra-4]



*Functionality :* 

* When a user login as an Admin role, user should able to access all the screens and create new role and Add users to the conttact management 
* When user login with Role other than Admin, user will not be able to create any role/user for connexus team but will able to create Role and add users  for client and Vendor.

column31:
+*Accetance Criteria:*+

*Contact  Management Browse Page: Login via Connexus Users*

* User should able to navigate to Client contact by clicking on Client tab from Contact managment
* Contact management page should display blank and should have a  field to select the organization from dropdown field 
* upon selecting the organization,it should display all the contacts under that client which are primary,secondary and onsite member.
* Filter should be there with values as *contact type(Primary,Secondary,Onsite member),status,Role name and authorize user* 
* The contact management list page should display all the clients under client tab
* Each user should be displayed as a row in the table.
* List page should have column headers as Name,Organization name,email address,contact type,Roles,Status,Created By 
* Created by should display the name of the user who created the current user 
* The page should display a pagination control at the bottom, allowing navigation through the user list.
* There should be a search bar to search users by name or email address.
* There should be a three dot button for each record which open the actions items to be performed on the contact managmeent list 
*  Three dot options should be *Edit,Delete,Resent,Deactivate,Authorize user,profile details*
* Status should be displayed as pending,active,Inactive.Status color code as Active -green color , Inactive -red color ,pending -blue color 
* if user clicks on three dot icon of an inactive user , only active option should be there. 

FIgma: 

[https://www.figma.com/design/HuFqPOMscB9vnvKq6nqyc9/Internal---Connexus-Design-System?node-id=72-199636&t=z29Dk8MsT87CZteF-4|https://www.figma.com/design/HuFqPOMscB9vnvKq6nqyc9/Internal---Connexus-Design-System?node-id=72-199636&t=z29Dk8MsT87CZteF-4|smart-link] 



*Contact Management Create Page: Login via Connexus Users*

* There should be a "Create" button on the contact management list page.
* Create button should be a dropdown with user type values as connexus team,Client,Vendor
* Clicking the "Create" button should open a form to enter the new user's details of user type as client
* The form should include fields for Organization name,First name ,last name, email address,title,position, phone number ,role, and status and user type,authorize user 
* There should be a "Create" button to save the new user and a "Cancel" button to discard the creation.
* Email address field should be unique
* Name field should accept only alphabets and it should not allow any numbers or special characters 
* Email fileld validation should be added for invalid emaild format or already existing emailids
* Roles should be a dropdown and it should list all the roles created for the selected user type
* Roles field should be a multi select field 
* Name field should be unique 
* Upon clicking on create , the new user should appear in the user management list.
* Email should be sent to the entered registered email with ocnfirmation message as email sent successfully
* Status of the created user should be pending and it should change to active when user clicks on the link from the email 
* created user should be part of the specified organization. 
* User should able to change the organization name from create page

column1: Client Onboarding List page
column31:
*Acceptence criteria :* 

*Client Onboaridng Browse Page*

* User should able to onboard a new client by navigating to the client tab present at the left navigation list
* A "Create" button should be present at the top-right corner of the page, allowing users to add a new client.
* The header should display the title "Client" with a subtitle "View and manage your clients."
* The client list should be displayed in a table format with the following columns:
** *Name*: Display the client name along with an icon representing the client's type (e.g., Multifamily, HOA).
** *Legal Name*: Legal name should be unique
** *Type*: Display the type of client (e.g.*Commercial,HOA,Multifamily,hotel retail*).
** *Parent Company*: Display the parent company, if applicable.
** *Approved Providers*: Indicate whether the client has approved providers (Yes/No).
** *Status*: Display the status of the client (Active/Inactive).
* Each row should include action buttons for viewing (eye icon) and editing (pencil icon) the client's details.
* The page should include filter options above the table, allowing users to filter clients by:
** Name
** Legal Name
** Approved Providers
** Type
* A search bar should be present to search for clients by company name
* If no clients match the search or filter criteria, the table should display a "No results found" message.
* The filter and search functionalities should update the table dynamically without requiring a page reload.
* The status indicator should change color based on the client’s status (e.g., green for Active, red for Inactive).
* Hovering over the action buttons should display tooltips indicating the action (e.g., "View", "Edit").
* The table should support pagination, allowing users to navigate through multiple pages of clients.

{code:sql}CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tbl_tenants" (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_name VARCHAR(250) NOT NULL,
    tenant_type tenant_types NOT NULL, -- client or vendor
    fk_parent_tenant_id UUID, -- Reference to the parent tenant (e.g., vendor or client)
    fk_parent_company_tenant_id UUID,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    modified_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (fk_parent_tenant_id) REFERENCES "tbl_tenants"(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

    created_by UUID,
    modified_by UUID
);

column1: Property List page
column31:
*Acceptance Criteria:* 

*Login as Connexus user:* 

* When user navigate to the Property list module it should have a blank list page with “*Organization name*" dropdown, "Filters" button, "Search" bar, and "Create" button.
* *Organization Name Dropdown:*
** Should list all the  organizations 
** Selecting an organization from the dropdown should filter the property list to show only those associated with the selected organization.
** Organization dropdown should be a single select.
* *Filter Button :*
** The "Filters" button should be visible and accessible  on the Property List page.
** Clicking the "Filters" button should open a modal, without delay with filter parameters and Apply and cancel button
** The filter interface should include options relevant to the properties, such as property Manager, status, County,State and status.
** Each filter option should provide appropriate controls (e.g., checkboxes, dropdowns, date pickers) that are clearly labeled.
** The interface should support multiple selections.
** Applied filters should correctly refine the property list results.
* *Search Bar:*
** Should allow users to search properties by keywords.
* *Create Button:*
** Should redirect the user to a form or page to add a new property.
** The button should be prominently displayed at the right hand corner of the screen
* *Property list table:*
** The table should list properties with columns for Property Name, Full Address, State/County, Property Manager, PM Email, and Status.
** Each property row should have options to edit or delete the property, represented by icons that are easy to understand and accessible.
** The Status column should show the value in different color code  to represent active or inactive statuses(Active -green,Inactive Red).
** Clicking on a property name or any editable field should allow users to edit the property directly or redirect to a detailed view/edit page.
** Sorting features should be available for at least the Property Name and Status columns, allowing users to sort properties in ascending or descending order.

column31:
# *Service Info Options*:

* Users can select if their service covers the continental US (Yes/No).
* When "No" is selected, fields for specifying locations by city, state, or county should be available.
* The UI should allow the addition of service areas by selecting a combination of city, state, and county.
* The form should ensure that  state ,city andcounty and  selections are mandatory when entering service locations.
* State field should be enabled and other fields city and county should be disabled. once the user selects the state , city and county should be enabled. 
* city and county data should be listed based on the state selected. State will be a single select and city and county are multi select dropdowns. 
* A Plus icon is available to add multiple states and their belonging cities and counties 
* Once the user add the stat,city and county and clicks on plus icon it will display as a record. 
* A dropdown should allow users to indicate if they are interested in receiving RFPs from regions outside their current service areas.Yes or NO. 
* If the value is yes then it shoud send the RFPs of same service to this vendor even if they are outside the service area location 

# *Branch Details*:

* A button to "Add Branch Details" should open a new form to enter branch-specific data.
* The user can enter branch legal name, address, city, state, and ZIP.
* Service coverage per branch (city, state, county) can be specified, with mandatory fields for locations covered by each branch.
* Branch can add the state,city,county. 
* Multiple state,city,county should be added 
* Grid should be available once the user add multiple states. 
*Branch Insurance Requirement*:
* A toggle option should be available to indicate if the branch requires a specific insurance document. If toggled, it prompts the user to upload or specify the required document.
* Insurance details include : 
Insurance file : upload file (Expected format: pdf,msword)
Policy ExpirationDate : date field
Days Left : Automatic field by calculating the days from current date -Expiration date
Notes: 
* *Add Branch Contact:*
** User can add the contact to specific branch by clicking on +contact button
** Once the user clicks on +contact it should open the dialog box. 
** User can add a new contact by selecting "Primary" or "Secondary" contact type.
** Required fields include: First Name, Last Name, Email.
** Contact is linked to the corresponding branch (e.g., "American Branch").
** "Add" button should save the contact and display it in the branch contact list.
* *Edit Contact:*
** User can edit an existing contact by selecting it from the branch contact list.
** Editable fields include: Contact Type, First Name, Last Name, Title, and Phone.
** Changes are saved by clicking the "Update" button.
** Updated contact details should be reflected in the branch contact list immediately after saving.
* *Franchise Details*:
** Tab options should allow users to switch between “Branch Details” and “Franchise Details.”
** On click on Add Franchise details, it should open the Add Franchise dialog box.
** All the Functionality and fields will be same as Branch

column31:
*Module:* Property Insurance → Pending Insurance
*Component:* Date Filter (Uploaded From / Uploaded To)

h4. *Issue Description*

When filtering records using *Uploaded From: Feb 03, 2026* and *Uploaded To: Feb 03, 2026*, the UI displays records with *Uploaded Date = Feb 04, 2026*.
However, in the *Network response*, the {{createdAt}} value for these records is clearly *Feb 03, 2026 (UTC)*, indicating a *date/time zone mismatch* between backend data and UI display.

h4. *Steps to Reproduce*

# Navigate to *Property Insurance → Pending Insurance*.
# Apply filter:
#* *Uploaded From:* Feb 03, 2026
#* *Uploaded To:* Feb 03, 2026
# Observe the listed records.
# Open *DevTools → Network → background-job API → Preview*.
# Check the {{createdAt}} field for a record shown as *Feb 04, 2026* in the UI.

h4. *Expected Behavior*

* When filtering for *Feb 03, 2026*, only records created on *Feb 03, 2026* should be displayed.
* UI date and filter logic should align with the backend {{createdAt}} value.
* Dates should be consistently handled using either:
** UTC everywhere, or
** User’s local timezone (IST), with proper conversion.

h4. *Actual Behavior*

* Records created on *Feb 03, 2026 (UTC)* are shown as *Feb 04, 2026* in the UI.
* These records still appear when filtering only for *Feb 03, 2026*, causing confusion and incorrect filtering results.

h4. *Evidence*

* Network response:
** {{createdAt: "2026-02-03T19:50:38.668Z"}} (UTC)
* UI display:
** Uploaded Date shown as *Feb 04, 2026*

h4. *Impact*

* Incorrect date filtering
* User confusion while validating uploads

h4. *Severity*

*High* (Data accuracy / filtering issue)

h4. *Probable Root Cause*

* Backend returns {{createdAt}} in *UTC*
* UI converts and displays date in *local timezone (IST)* without adjusting filter logic
* Filter comparison is done on *local date* while API data remains in *UTC*

h4. *Suggested Fix*

* Normalize date handling by:
** Converting {{createdAt}} to local timezone *before filtering*, or
** Performing filtering in *UTC* and displaying converted local dates consistently
* Clearly define timezone handling for date filters

Because of this limitation, if we need a longer expiry window (e.g., 24 hours), we would have to implement a custom forgot/reset password flow on our side (generate token, store with expiry, validate, and then update password via backend)

column1: Search Functionality Returns Irrelevant Results for Keyword with Special Character (“_”)
column31:
h3. *Module:*

Manage Vendor Invite → Email Audit Tab

h3. *Description:*

When searching using a keyword containing an underscore (e.g., “EM_”), the system returns results that do not exactly match the given keyword. The search behaves like a loose substring match and ignores the underscore, leading to irrelevant records being displayed.

h3. *Steps to Reproduce:*

# Navigate to *Manage Vendor Invite* page
# Go to the *Email Audit* tab
# Enter *“EM_”* in the search bar
# Observe the search results

h3. *Actual Result:*

The system returns records such as:

* “Shin_EmailSent_Vendor” (contains “Email” but not “EM_”)
* Other partial matches that include “EM” but not the exact keyword “EM_”

h3. *Expected Result:*

Search results should:

* Return only records that contain the exact keyword *“EM_”*, OR
* Follow a clearly defined and consistent search logic (e.g., exact match, prefix match, etc.)

For “EM_”, expected matches should include:

* ✅ EM_Branch
* ❌ Shin_EmailSent_Vendor (should not appear)

*Screenshots*

!image-20260427-090954.png|width=663,alt="image-20260427-090954.png"!
column617:
27/Apr/26 3:42 PM;62b94087268cac6e31c32ca4;[~accountid:6200d7cd5d18ad0072987c6f] Root cause: recipient search uses PostgreSQL {{ILIKE}}, where {{_}} and {{%}} act as wildcards. So values like {{em_}} don’t match the literal string, but instead match {{em}} followed by any single character (e.g., {{ema}}, {{emb}}, {{em }}), causing incorrect results when these characters are part of vendor names or emails.

This can be fixed by escaping these characters and using {{ILIKE}} with {{ESCAPE}} so they are treated literally. However, this change needs to be applied across all similar search queries wherever this issue exists.

column1: Restrict Policy Visibility Based on Property Linked to Logged-in Contact
column31:
*Module:* Property Insurance

*Description:*
When a client has multiple contacts (e.g., 2 contacts) and each contact is linked to different properties, the logged-in user should only be able to view policies associated with the properties linked to their contact account.

*Current Behavior:*
Users are able to view policies for all properties under the client, even if those properties are not linked to their contact account.

*Expected Behavior:*

* The system should restrict policy visibility based on property–contact mapping.
* A logged-in contact should only see policies related to the properties assigned to them.
* Policies linked to other properties (not mapped to the logged-in contact) should not be visible.

*Impact:*
This is a data access control issue and may expose policies to unauthorized contacts.
column617:
05/May/26 4:35 PM;61e900cef0ed0400689392d4;[~accountid:63c8e40fd579d7c687552750] [~accountid:6200d7cd5d18ad0072987c6f] 
This issue is blocked by the absence of a permission/ability module for {{property-insurance}}. Unlike other modules (e.g., contracts), this module has no CASL integration — no {{@CheckPermission}} guards, no permission handler, and no {{getAbilityFilters()}} usage to scope data by user role or property access. Without this, we cannot enforce who can view/edit which insurance policies based on their user type or assigned properties. Any ad-hoc fix would be inconsistent with the existing permission architecture and would need to be rewritten. This needs to be addressed as part of a proper permission module implementation for property insurance.

h3. *Description:*

On the *Send for Signatures* page, the *Signee dropdown* under the “Add Recipients” section does not load any values when the user clicks it for the first time. The user must click the dropdown multiple times before the options become visible.

h3. *Steps to Reproduce:*

# Confirm a contract and navigate to the *Send for Signatures* page.
# In the *Add Recipients* table, click on the *Signee* dropdown for any recipient.
# Observe that the dropdown list does not display any options on the first click.
# Click the dropdown again (sometimes multiple times).
# On repeated clicks, the list finally appears.

h3. *Expected Result:*

* Signee dropdown should load and display all available signature placeholders *immediately on the first click*.

h3. *Actual Result:*

* Signee dropdown *does not show any options initially*.
* User must click *2–3 times* to make the placeholder list appear.

h3. *Impact:*

* Causes confusion and delays in configuring recipients.
* Appears as though no placeholders are available, which may lead to incorrect assumptions or user errors.
* Affects overall usability and smoothness of the e-signature workflow.

h3. *ScreenRecord Reference:*

(From user: Signee dropdown shows “Select Placeholder” but no values appear initially.)

column1: Copy Functionality — Success Toast Displayed Despite Network Error (Data Not Actually Copied)
column31:
h3. *Summary:*

When copying *cost values* and *documents* from the source property to other properties, the system displays a *network error* and simultaneously shows a *success toast message*. However, the copy action does *not actually complete*, and the details are *not copied* to the selected properties. This creates confusion and gives a false impression that the operation succeeded.

----

h3. *Steps to Replicate:*

# Navigate to the *Vendor Submission Form* in the RFP module.
# Select a property that has cost values and/or documents.
# Click on the *Copy* icon and select one or more target properties.
# Click *Copy button* to initiate the copy action.
# Observe that a *network error* is displayed.
# At the same time, a *success toast* appears indicating that the data was copied successfully.
# Verify that the selected target properties do *not* have the copied cost values or documents.

----

h3. *Expected Result:*

* The system should display *only the correct message* based on the operation’s outcome.
* If a network error occurs, the *success toast should not appear*.
* The success message should be shown *only after* verifying that the data has been successfully copied to all selected properties.

----

h3. *Actual Result:*

* A *network error* and a *success toast* appear simultaneously.

column1: Duplicate Property Legal Name allowed across the system due to space handling
column31:
h3. Module

*Property → Create / Update (Client context)*

----

h2. Current Behavior

The system allows creation of multiple properties with the same *Property Legal Name* by treating spaces as valid/distinct characters.

Examples that currently pass validation:

* {{Property Test Legal}}
* {{Property Test Legal }}(trailing space)
* {{Property Test Legal}} (leading space)
* {{Property Test Legal}} (multiple internal spaces)

As a result, duplicate Property Legal Names exist *across the entire system*.

----

h2. Expected Behavior

*Property Legal Name must be globally unique across the system*, regardless of client.

The system should:

* Trim leading and trailing spaces
* Normalize multiple spaces into a single space
* Perform uniqueness validation on the normalized value
* Prevent duplicate creation or update anywhere in the system

----

h2. Scope

* Applies to:
** *Create Property*
** *Update Property*
* Uniqueness is *global*, not client-specific

h2. Validation & Fix Recommendation

h3. Backend (Mandatory)

# Normalize Property Legal Name before validation and persistence:
#* Trim leading & trailing spaces
#* Replace multiple consecutive spaces with a single space
#* Case-insensitive comparison (recommended)
# Apply uniqueness check on:
#* {{normalized_property_legal_name}}

h2. Acceptance Criteria

* User cannot create or update a property with a Property Legal Name that already exists anywhere in the system
* Leading/trailing/multiple spaces do not allow duplicates
* Validation works consistently across Create and Update flows
* Error messaging is clear and user-friendly

*Visual Proof :* [https://jam.dev/c/9327ea4c-451f-41a6-82d9-ff68e28d7d5c|https://jam.dev/c/9327ea4c-451f-41a6-82d9-ff68e28d7d5c|smart-link]

column1: [TRELLO] RFP Process - Vendor side pieces
column31:
This ticket encompasses the areas of

 

* Sending RFP’s out to vendors and how that process will work
* Confirming the right vendors are getting the contracts
* Accept/Reject RFP and notes
* Post-RFP communication to vendors
* The vendor profile and dashboard

 

*Vendors out to bid:*

To better support the vendor side of the RFP process, we need to make it easier when RFP’s go out to bid to confirm we have the right vendors as part of that process. To effectively do so, as part of the V1 experience, we need to make sure we have fully-encompassed service areas with county, city and state. However, we should also consider using something like AI to see if a vendors service area matches the properties and area for an RFP. We can potentially do this based on the service area listed on their website or what they input to their own portal. However, the goal is to have more vendors that we can include in an RFP process versus less as long as the criteria is met.  As a V2, this should be dynamic with a map where as part of the vendor onboarding, they can outline their service area on a map and if plotted properties overlap, we include them in the RFP process.

The other scenario is that a client has their own existing vendor network. We will need the names/emails of those vendors to then include them in the RFP process. Upon initial login, we’ll need them to add pertinent vendor information so we have it for future use.

 

As a side, we _should_ be looking to eventually turn this into an RFP marketplace, where any approved Connexus vendor can login and see open RFP’s for their service and service area and choose whether to submit. [~accountid:heathermoore45] has sent you the link for San Diego’s marketplace pertaining to housing vendors and something basic like that would work as an MVP for that eventual experience.

 

*Accept/Reject of RFP’s:*

To strengthen our knowledge base of who we are sending RFP’s too, we need to understand our view rates, acceptance rates and why vendors may be rejecting RFP’s. Clients and Connexus team should be able to go in and see this level of data - Did the vendor open the email? Did the click the link/login to view the RFP? Did they submit an RFP? Also, allow them to reject it and leave a reason why. Is it because they are too busy? Wrong service area? etc. Ops would then be able to use that data to update vendors information accordingly.

 

*Vendor profile and dashboard:*

Vendors need their profiles to be filled out completely with their business information, while also having more from Connexus. This would be a dashboard where they can see their existing contracts, open RFP’s, rejected RFP’s, etc. We want vendors to be engaged and need to include information for them to do so.

[~accountid:nishacn1] not on our weekly calls, but we should review the figma and see how some of this fits in or needs to be incorporated for the RFP project.

column1: Need confirmation dialog box when attempting to deactivate a Service or Property that is linked to SOWs or RFPs
column31:
*Description* 

To prevent accidental data disruption, a confirmation dialog box should be displayed when a user attempts to deactivate a Service or Property that is linked with one or more active SOWs (Scope of Work) or RFPs (Request for Proposal). 

This dialog should clearly notify the user of the link and seek explicit confirmation before proceeding with the deactivation.

*Expected Behavior*

* When deactivating a Service or Property with active associations to SOWs/RFPs, a confirmation dialog should appear.
* The dialog should display a message such as: _“_*Deactivate Service/Property: [Service/Property Name]?*
This Service/Property is currently linked to SOWs and  RFPs (number can be specified)
_“_ 
* The user must confirm the action to proceed; otherwise, deactivation is canceled.

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Confirmation dialog is triggered only when links to SOWs/RFPs exist.
* Dialog message is clearly worded and includes Cancel/Confirm options.
* No deactivation occurs unless confirmation is explicitly given.

column31:
There is another scenario where we need to update the contract PDF file due to changes in the contract terms. In such cases, we should have the option to reupload the PDF file accordingly.

Suggested Implementation : Enable PDF Reupload Functionality for Existing Contracts

*📌 Description:*
Currently, the "Existing Contracts Preview" does not support reuploading PDF files. However, in scenarios where contract terms change, clients require the ability to update the existing contract by reuploading the revised PDF file. This enhancement should allow users to replace the original contract document with a new version while maintaining existing contract metadata.

*🎯 Client Requirement:*
Clients have specifically requested the ability to reupload updated contract PDFs when contract terms are modified.

*📝 Proposed Enhancement:*

* Add a "Reupload PDF" option to the Existing Contracts Preview interface
* Include validation to confirm proper file format and integrity
* Provide UI feedback on successful or failed upload attempts

*✅ Acceptance Criteria:*

* Users can select and reupload a new PDF for an existing contract
* The new file replaces the previous document in preview
* Changes are properly tracked and reflected in the preview

Scope Of Work module in the Connexus Living platform.

* Tooltip/message should appear on hover or focus to clarify the restriction.
* Ensure consistent behavior across all service categories and SOW entries.

* [ ] Validate tooltip/message accuracy and visibility.
* [ ] Ensure dropdowns remain editable when SOW is not linked.

*📝 Description:*

When selecting a client in the filters, the other filters (Services, States, City, Vendor) still display all available options from the system instead of narrowing down to only those related to the chosen client.

*Where:*
Contract Management → Existing Contracts → Filters.

This causes confusion and inefficiency, as users must scroll through irrelevant filter options. It can also lead to incorrect filtering and wasted time.

# Navigate to *Contract Management → Existing Contracts*.

column1: Contract Management – Hardcoded Services in Prompt Prevent Dynamic Contract Completion
column31:
*📝 Description:*

*What:*
When processing uploaded contracts, the dashboard only checks for a predefined (hardcoded) list of services in the prompt. If the detected service matches one of these hardcoded services, the contract is automatically marked as complete.

*Where:*
Contract Management module → File Upload section.

*Expected:*
*The contract completion logic should dynamically detect and process* *_all_* *services available in the system without requiring them to be hardcoded into the prompt.* This would eliminate the need to repeatedly update the prompt for new services.

*Impact:*

* Contracts containing valid services that are not in the hardcoded prompt list are not auto-completed.
* Admins must manually complete these contracts, increasing workload and turnaround time.
* The system requires ongoing manual maintenance of the service list and prompt.

*Steps to Reproduce:*

# Navigate to *Contract Management → File Upload*.
# Upload a contract containing a service that exists in the system but is not part of the hardcoded service list in the prompt.
# Observe that the contract remains in "Pending for Approval" instead of being auto-completed.

# *Header Information:*

#* "Authorize User" button are available for vendor-related actions.
#* The page header includes options to edit, delete, and view additional actions for the vendor.
#* Three dot menu should show *Manage Roles & contacts* option to navigate to contact management and Role management modules if they have access to those modules
# *Navigation Tabs:*
#* Tabs are available for the following sections: Company Info, Ownership Info, Approved Clients, Received RFP, Related Proposal Submission, and Current Contracts.
#* The “Company Info” tab is selected by default upon loading the page.
# *Company Details:*
#* Legal name, address, services provided, and notes/recognition are displayed under “Company Details.”
#* User should able to edit the basic company information by clicking on main edit icon.
# *Vendor Contacts:*
#* Contacts are separated into "Primary" and "Secondary" sections with appropriate tabs.
#* Contact list displays columns for Title, First Name, Last Name, Email, and Phone.
#* Users can add, edit, or remove contacts using the “Add” button or edit/delete icons.
#* A confirmation is required for contact deletion, and a success message should appear after successful addition or modification.
# *Branch Details:*

#* Each branch has an "Edit" button to modify details and a "Contact" button to view or add branch-specific contacts.
#* A pop-up appears when adding or editing branch details, allowing users to save changes.
# *Validation and Messaging:*
#* Each field displays appropriate validation messages for missing or invalid data.
#* After successfully updating any section, a success message should confirm that changes have been saved.

 Year Built  field will be an year field from *1900* to *current year*.

      commercial type Values: *Retail, Office, Industrial, Mixed Use*

      comercial classification values: *Class A, Class B, Class C*

       *Metrics will be a sub section under that* : *Gross Square Footage* &  *Rentable Square Footage* (both fields should accept only numbers )

# IF the client type is Commercial : “*commercial type"* , "*commercial classification*”, “*Metrics*“ Fields 

      commercial type Values: *Retail, Office, Industrial, Mixed Use*

      comercial classification values: *Class A, Class B, Class C*

Each service row should have an actions menu (three dots) with the following options:
#* *Edit*: To edit the service details.

column1: Service Create Page
column31:
*Acceptance Criteria*

As a user i should able to create New service and under each service i should able to create sub-services.

# *Form Fields:*
The page should display the following fields:
#* *Service Name* (required): A text input field for entering the name of the service, marked as mandatory.
#* *Service Description* (optional): A multi-line text area for entering a description of the service.
#* *Sub-service Name* (optional): A text input field for adding a sub-service name, with a plus (+) icon to add multiple sub-services.
#* *Sub-service Description* (optional): A multi-line text area for entering a description for the sub-service.
# *Dynamic Sub-Service Addition:*
#* The *Sub-service Name* field should allow the user to add multiple sub-services by clicking the plus (+) icon.
#* After adding a sub-service, a new row should appear for additional sub-services.
# *Create Service Button:*
#* A *Create Service* button should be available at the bottom of the form to submit the service details.
#* Clicking the *Create Service* button should validate the required fields and display an error message if the *Service Name* is missing.
# *Cancel Button:*
#* A *Cancel* button should be present, which when clicked, closes the form without saving the entered details.
# *Validation and Error Handling:*
#* If the *Service Name* is left blank, an inline validation message should appear beneath the field (e.g., "Service Name is required").
# *Modal Window:*
#* The form should open as a modal overlay on the page.
#* The modal should have a *Close (X)* icon in the top-right corner to allow users to close the form without saving.
# *Default Text/Placeholder:*
#* Each input field should display appropriate placeholder text (e.g., "Enter service name" for *Service Name*).
#* The *Service Description* and *Sub-service Description* should display placeholder lorem ipsum text as shown in the image.

*Functionality*

* When user clicks on create after adding the services and sub-services, it should validate for uniqueness of service name throughout the system
* Services and sub-services will be unique across the system, and the same name cannot be used for both a service and a sub-service.
* Once the service and subservices are created, it will display as a record in the service list page. 
* Toolitip on Services column will help to show the Service description
* When user add multiple Subservices under same service it will show as a record with two links: View and delete 
* User should able to click on view link for viewing the subservice description and should able to remove the subservice by clicking on delete option 
* Scroll bar should be avaiable if there are multiple sub-services are added

column1: Property Mapping via client contact list tab
column31:
*Acceptance Criteria*

As a user i should able to view all the contacts under the client and should able to map the 

h3. 1. *Contacts Display:*

* The page must display a list of all contacts created from the client, property, or contact management side.
* Contacts should be displayed in a table format with the following columns:
** *Type*: Displays the type of contact (Primary, Secondary, Onsite member, etc.).
** *Title*: The job title of the contact (e.g., Manager, Marketing Head).
** *First Name* and *Last Name*: The contact’s name.
** *Email*: The email address of the contact.
** *Phone*: The contact's phone number.

h3. 2. *Actions:*

* Each contact should have an options menu (3-dot icon) with the following actions:
** *Edit*: Allows editing of the contact details.
** *Delete*: Deletes the contact from the list after confirmation.
** *Mark as Primary*: Marks the contact as a primary contact (should replace the current primary if one exists).
** *Mark as Secondary*: Marks the contact as a secondary contact.
** *Mark as Onsite Member*: Marks the contact as an onsite member.
** *Link to Specific Properties*: Allows linking the contact to specific properties.

h3. 3. *Add New Contact:*

* There should be an *Add* button that allows users to create a new contact.
* Upon clicking *Add*, a form should appear to fill in contact details, such as type, title, first name, last name, email, and phone number.

h3. 4. *Filter and Search:*

* A *Type* dropdown filter should allow users to filter contacts by their type (e.g., Primary, Secondary, Onsite Member).
* A *Search* field should enable searching contacts by name, email, or phone number.
* The contact list should support pagination, with navigation arrows at the bottom (left, right, and specific page numbers).
* The total number of contacts should determine the number of pages.
* The top of the page should display the client's information (e.g., *Acento* and *Multifamily* in the image), allowing users to know which client the contact list belongs to.

User should able to click on link to specific properties link for mapping the user to specific properties 

*Link To specific Properties* 

* When the user clicks on the "Link to Specific Properties" option from the action menu of a contact in the client contact list, the modal should open.
* The modal should display the contact's name and role (e.g., David John, Manager).
* The modal should have two main options for linking:
** *Client Level*: For linking the contact to the all the Properties under the client
** *Property Level*: For linking the contact to specific properties.
** If the user selects *Property Level*, a multi-select dropdown should appear allowing the user to choose specific properties.
** The dropdown should list all available properties under the client.
** Users should be able to select multiple properties at once.
** The selected properties should appear as tags below the dropdown.
** *Cancel Button*: Closes the modal without saving any changes.
** *Save Button*: Saves the selected properties or client level association.
** If no property is selected under "Property Level," the user should not be able to click "Save," and an error or warning should be displayed prompting them to select at least one property.

h3. Different Users who can map to properties: 

* All corporate Primary and secondary contacts will have client level permission and htey will be able to see all properties 
* All primary contacts can change to property level and they will be able to see the filtered property list 
* All other contacts can be added under client leve or property level

column1: Vendor Permission Mapping with Roles Management
column31:
*Acceptance Criteria*

*Role Managment Change*

As a Connexus Admin, I should able to create Roles specific for vendor organizations,branches and Franchise. 

_Vendor Roles List page_

* When connexus admin login to the system, user should able to navigate to Roles tab. under vendor section List tab there should be an  organization name selection field,branch/Franchise choosing option and branch/Franchise name selection field. 
* If user selects any vendor organization name only and left branch/franchise as null , it will show all the roles created under the vendor organization. these roles will be assigned to the main contacts of vendor contacts or contacts created under the vendor 
* If user selects any vendor organization name and branch/franchise as branch, it will show branch name field to select the branches under the selected vendor 
* If user selects any branch then it will show all Roles associated with the corresponding organization and branch

*Role Creation Screen*

* On click on vendor Role creation, user can create a role for organization or branch specific or Franchise Specific
* If user selects only organization and left Branch/Franchise field, it will create a Role specific to Vendor Main contacts and it will not be applicable for branch/Franchise
* If the user selects the branch and select one of the branch under Vendor, then it will create a Role specific to Selected branch
* If the user selects the Franchise and select one of the Franchise under Vendor, then it will create a Role specific to Selected franchise
* Branch field and Franchise field will be single select
* If user creates a role for  branch then, it will show under the branches list page under vendor 
* If user creates a role for Franchise then, it will show under the Franchise list page under vendor 
* If user creates a role organization specific then it will be visible under organization roles 
* In Role Edit, branch/Franchise field and Organization field,Role name  will be disabled and user can change only the permission. 
* If you are creating a Role for Vendor, then permission set will have : Vendor Managment,Vendor Contacts,Branch,Franchise
* If user is creating a Role for Branch, then Branch screen should be visible
* If user is creating a Role for Franchise, then Franchise screen should be visible

*Login As Connexus Admin* 

* *Connexus user permission will be set under Roles->Connexus User.* 
* If the user require Vendor permission it should able to set in Permission for vnedor managment under connexus User. 
* If user is logged in as connexus admin/any users, they will have 4 screens will be visible under vnedor managment: 
 Vendor Management 
Vendor Contacts
 Branch
 Branch Contacts
 Franchise
Franchise Contacts
*   User can create a role for vendor with all these screens or either one of them. 
* If user selects only vendor Management then user can create,Edit,Deactivate the created vendor and will be able to access detail page but will not be able to see the  contacts and branch and franchise details 
* If user selects only vendor Contacts then user can create,Edit,Deactivate the created vendor and will be able to access detail page but will not be able to see the branch and franchise details 
* If user selects only vendor branch/Franchise then user can create,Edit,Deactivate the created vendor and will be able to access detail page but will not be able to see the contacts but able to biew branch/Franchise.
* If user selects All 4 screens,then user has the ability to create the vendor and view all the details of the vendor
* *If the connexus user needs to create a role for the vendor contacts then they need to create under vendor tab.Role->Vendor*
*  Under vendor Tab, Role can be created by choosing the organization or branch or Franchise 
* If the user only selects organization then the set permission will be applicable to only vendor main contacts. All branch contacts or Franchise contacts will not be able to access this role while authorizing a branch/Franchise contact
* If the user selects branch as an option after selecting Organization then it will ask for selecting the branche under the organization. Set permission will be applicable only for the selected brnach and it will not be applicable to organization or Franchise contacts.
* If the user selects Franhise as an option after selecting Organization then it will ask for selecting the Franchise under the organization. Set permission will be applicable only for the selected franchise and it will not be applicable to organization or Branch contacts

*Login As Vendor Admin* 

* If user is logged in as vendor admin, then all 4 screen permission will be visible under vendor managment.
Vendor managment create permission will be disabled and all the other edit and delete functionality will be enabled 
* Remaining 3 screens will have all the permissions enabled 
* Vendor admin will have the contact and Role managmeent access
* Contact managment and ROle management will be disabled for creating a new role

*Login As Branch Admin* 

* If user is logged in as Branch admin, only branch screen will be visible under vendor managment.
Branch create permission will be disabled and all the other edit and delete functionality will be enabled 
* Contact managment and ROle management will be disabled for creating a new role

*Login As Franchise Admin* 

* If user is logged in as Franchise admin, only Franchise screen will be visible under vendor managment.
Fracnhise create permission will be disabled and all the other edit and delete functionality will be enabled 
* Contact managment and ROle management will be disabled for creating a new role

column1: Vendor Permission Mapping
column31:
*Acceptance criteria:* 

As a vendor parent company contact or vendor  main contact or vendor branch contact or vendor franchise contact, I should able to login to the application and see only pages which i have access to.

*Vendor Permission for different users :* 

*a) Vendor login as a parent company main contact*

* When a parent company main contact (primary or secondary),by default parent company vendor  details will be visible when they select vendor  from navigation bar
* In the side nav bar workspace selection place will be visible and user will be able to able to switch to their child companies from the system
* when a main contact is logged in, only *view* permission will be available for the user to its child and its branches. Any create or Edit or Deleate operation permissions will not be availble for its child companies and its branches 
* When main contact switch from parent company to child company,they should able to see the child company details list and on expand they can see the corresponding   child company’s  branch and Franchise list.
* When main contact switch from parent company to main child company,it will show the child company detail page and its main contacts 
* When main contact switch from parent company to main child company’s branch ,it will show the branch  detail page and its main contacts.
* Franchise will be disabled and user cannot switch to Franchise company
* Nested childcompanies will not be included in the scope. ie, if the child company is already parent of some other company,then this parent company cannot have access to the child’s child company. 

*b) Vendor login as a child company main contact*

* When a main contact of child company logins to the application,Workspace list shows all the branches and franchise under the corresponding child company. 
* When main contact switch from child company to its branches, it will show the branch detail page and branch contacts. *User will have the permission same as the vendor main contact*  to its branches 
* When main contact switch from child company to its Franchise, it will show the Franchise detail page and Franchise contacts.  Franchise will be disabled
* But When a child company is parent of some other company then it will show the child company also in the list. Else it will show only branches and franchise. 
* If there are no branches or Franhcise under the child company then it will not have a workspace. 

*c) Vendor login as a  branch/Franchise main contact*

* When main contact of branch login to the system, user will be able to view the branch ddetail pag and its contact 
* If the main contact has access to multiple branches then it will show as a workspaces and user can switch  to the other brnaches from the list. 
* if the main contact has access to multiple branches,default branch will be visible first when user logs in and the permission depends on the default permission added while authorizing. All the other branches will have the same permission of default branch.
* When main contact of franchise login to the system user will be able to view the franchise detail page and its contacts

column1: Vendor Onboarding Create Page : Company Info &Contact Info
column31:
*Acceptance criteria:*

As a user am able to create vendor and onboard the vendor with relevant data. 

# *Step-by-Step Navigation*:
#* The vendor creation process should be divided into 4 steps:
#*# *Company Info*
#*# *Contact Info*
#*# *Service Details*
#*# *Ownership Details*
#* Users should be able to move to the next step using the *Next* button.
#* Users should not proceed without filling in required fields.
#* At the last step, a *Create* button should submit the form after all required fields in each step are completed.
#* An error message should appear if required fields are missing.
#* The active step should be visually distinguished (e.g., bold or highlighted).
#* Steps not yet completed should appear disabled until prior steps are finished.

h3. Step 1: Company Info

# *Company Details*:
#* *Parent Company*: Dropdown selection for parent company.
#* *Company Name*: Required field for the vendor’s company name.this should be an input field.
#* *Legal Name*: Required field for legal name. this field should be a unique name but a non mandatory field.
#* *Logo Upload*: Ability to upload a company logo.this should accept png,jpg 
#* *Services*: Dropdown to select the services the vendor provides (required). It should display all the active services in the connexus system which will be available under services module
#*User can also request a new service from the dropdown.if a service is entered in the search field which is not there in the connexus existing services then it will show a button 'Request as New'.* 
If user clicks on Request as new option. a service request will added and will make a service request to the connexus user. 
Requested service color code will be different compared to existing services.
Confirmation message will be displayed when a new service request is added 
#* *Status*: Dropdown to set the vendor's status (Active/Inactive).
#* *Lead Sources*: Dropdown to choose the source of the vendor lead.

*Next*: Clicking the "Next" button should navigate the user to step 3 (Service Details) only if the required fields are filled.
*Create*: Clicking "Create" should save the current vendor creation progress.Create should be disabled or removed.

** *Address*: Free-text input for the vendor’s address.
** *City*: Dropdown with available City  options.
** *State*: Dropdown with available state options.
** *County*: Dropdown with available counties (marked as mandatory).
** *ZIP Code*: Free-text input for the ZIP code (marked as mandatory).

*Contact Details Section*

* The user should be able to toggle between *Primary* and *Secondary* contact details.
* Under the *Primary* tab, users should be able to:
** *Add Contact Details*: A button to add a new contact under contact. 
* All contacts with type primary will be view under primary and with type secondary will be added in the secondary tab

h3. *Contact Details Section*

# *Primary Tab:*

The user should be able to view and manage multiple contact details in a table format.

** *Title*: Job title of the contact (e.g., Manager, Marketing Head).
** *First Name*: The first name of the contact.
** *Last Name*: The last name of the contact.
** *Email*: The email address of the contact.
** *Phone*: The contact's phone number.

*#* Phone number should accept only numeric values and must have a valid format.

*# *Cancel Action*:

column1: QA Suggestion : Add Hover and Selection Highlights for UI Elements
column31:
*Summary* 

The system currently does not provide hover highlights or visual feedback for the following UI elements, making the interface less interactive and less user-friendly:

* Text: 'File Upload' and 'Existing Contacts'
* File Upload Button
* Arrow Buttons (e.g., for navigation)
* Numbers in Pagination
* Selected Pagination Number
* Search bar
* Close button on 'Select Client Name' modal

*Suggested Improvements:*

# *Hover Highlights:*
#* Add a hover effect (e.g., color change, underline, or background highlight) for all listed elements to provide clear visual feedback to the user.
#* For buttons and interactive text, consider a slight shadow or color gradient effect to indicate interactivity.
# *Selected Pagination Highlight:*
#* Ensure that the currently selected pagination number is highlighted (e.g., bold text, background color, or border). This helps users identify their current position in the pagination.

*Benefits:*

* Improved user experience 
* Enhanced accessibility for users by making it easier to identify hoverable and selected states.

*Implementation Notes:*

* Use consistent CSS for hover states across the application.
* Test the behavior on different devices and screen sizes to ensure responsiveness.

*Steps To Replicate*

# Login to the application
# Click on ‘Contract Management’ on the left side nav menu
# Observe the Hover and Selection Highlights for each UI Elements

*Expected Result:* 

Each UI element that is hoverable and selected should have highlights as mentioned in the description.

column1: Decimal Point Deletion Issue: Decimal Point Disappears After Entering A Number
column31:
*Summary* 

Note : Issue exists in Early Termination Fee and Annual Contract Value number fields

When a user enters a decimal point followed by a number, {color:#bf2600}the decimal point is automatically deleted, and the number is not displayed. {color}Additionally, when a user enters a decimal point and then types "0", both the decimal point and the value will be displayed. However, if the user enters any other number after "0",{color:#bf2600} both the "0" and the decimal point are deleted.{color} When entering a lengthy number, at some point, the decimal point will remain visible. When enter 'E' then all the entered digits will be deleted.



*Steps To Replicate*

* Log in to the application
* Click on Contract Management
* Click on the Existing Contract tab name
* Click on any contracts
* Enter a number then enter decimal point
* Enter a number after the decimal point (e.g., "1").
** Observe: The decimal point disappears, and the number is not displayed.
* Now enter a decimal point (".") followed by "0" (e.g., ".0").
** Observe: Both the decimal point and the "0" are displayed.
* Enter another number after "0" (e.g., ".01" or ".10").
** Observe: Both the "0" and the decimal point are deleted, and the number is not displayed.
* Enter a lengthy number then enter the decimal point and then enter the number

           Observe: All the values are displayed including the decimal point

* After entering some numbers enter the letter 'E' 

       Observe: All the number are deleted automatically



*Expected Result:* 

* The decimal point should remain when a number is entered after it.
* The input should display the full value (e.g., ".01" or ".10") without any automatic deletions.
* There should be no unexpected deletion of the decimal point or number when the user enters a valid sequence.
* No unexpected actions should occur when the user tries to enter letters.

*Actual Result*

* The decimal point should remain when a number is entered after it.
* The input should display the full value (e.g., ".01" or ".10") without any automatic deletions.
* There should be no unexpected deletion of the decimal point or number when the user enters a valid sequence.
* When entering the letter *'E'* in the input field that already contains numbers, all previously entered numbers are deleted unexpectedly.

*Screenshots*

column1: Drag & Drop Feature in contract upload AI
column31:
*Summary* : 

Drag & Drop Feature in contract upload AI



*Acceptance criteria*

* User should able to drag and drop feature in the contract upload feature
* User should able to  choose the file type whether its zip or pdf
* when user selects zip, it should show the bulk upload feature and user can upload only zip file extension. 
if the user selects pdf it should show the bulk upload feature and user can upload only pdf extension. 
* When pdf extension is selected then user should have the ability to upload single or multiple pdf files using drag and drop
* drag and drop,cntrl+ A functionality should also work. 
* once the user select the files it should display in the same uploaded files as a list with status 
* if the files are invalid it should show the error below the file  name and show the status as error. 
* user should able to have confirm button to reconfrim the selected files 
* if the error files are not removed and clicks on confirm button it should show validation
* user should able to remove the files before confirming the upload 
* During upload process, progress bar should be displayed to show the status and if its completed it should change the status to completed. 
* during upload system should check whether the duplicate contract is uploaded or [not.it|http://not.it] should show validation if its duplicated
* confirmation message should be displayed once the upload process completed 
* user should have a reupload feature to reupload the failed files again. 
* once the user clicks on reupload button it should reupload only the failed fiels 
* During upload feature it should show the availalble  memory space of current user’s system. 

PF the figma link: 
[https://www.figma.com/design/HuFqPOMscB9vnvKq6nqyc9/Internal---Connexus-Design-System?node-id=7197-356070&t=zatvSpWvFS01x1Df-4|https://www.figma.com/design/HuFqPOMscB9vnvKq6nqyc9/Internal---Connexus-Design-System?node-id=7197-356070&t=zatvSpWvFS01x1Df-4]

*Steps To Replicate*

* Navigate to the file upload interface for a specific client.
* Select and upload a file.
* Attempt to upload the same file under a *different client.*



*Expected Result:* 

* Duplication validation should occur *only* at the client level.
* A duplication error should display *only* if the file exists under the same client.

*Actual Result*

* Duplication validation is applied globally across all clients.

column1: Incorrect Toaster Notifications and Missing File During Slow Network Upload
column31:

When uploading a file and the network connection slows to 3G, the system displays conflicting toaster notifications: a *success toaster* and an *upload cancelled due to slow network toaster*. Additionally, the file does not appear in the uploaded files list, creating ambiguity about the upload status.



*Steps To Replicate*

* Begin the upload process under normal network conditions.
* Simulate or experience a slowdown to a 3G network during the upload.
* Observe the toaster notifications and verify the uploaded files list.



*Expected Result:* 

* Only one appropriate toaster notification should be displayed, clearly indicating the upload status (success or failure).
* If the file upload is cancelled due to the slow network, it should be clearly indicated, and the file should not be listed.
* If the upload is successful, the file should appear in the uploaded files list.

*Actual Result*

column1: Validation Error When Pasting Email ID Copied from Copilot
column31:
*Summary* 

The application displays a validation error when pasting an email ID that has been copied from Microsoft Copilot. This issue does not occur when email addresses are copied from other platform such as Google, Google Chats.



*Steps To Replicate*

# Generate an email id in Copiolot
# Copy it 
# Open ConneXus 
# Go to the client create page
# Paste the mail id into the email field
# Observe the validation error displayed



*Expected Result:* 

The email ID copied from Copilot should be treated as valid and accepted without errors, similar to email IDs copied from other platforms.

*Actual Result*

The email validation fails, displaying an error message when pasting an email ID copied from Copilot.

*Additional Notes:* Issue persist in all the email fields across the application.

*Screenshots*

[https://jam.dev/c/37a2b7de-3940-4311-a432-1429a7ccd7eb|https://jam.dev/c/37a2b7de-3940-4311-a432-1429a7ccd7eb|smart-link]
column617:
28/Mar/25 11:38 AM;61e900cef0ed0400689392d4;[~accountid:6200d7cd5d18ad0072987c6f] , [~accountid:63c8e40fd579d7c687552750] 

*Issue:*
When copying an email address from GitHub Copilot, non-visible formatting characters are included in the clipboard content. These extra characters cause our email validation regex to fail. Pasting the same address from a plain-text source (e.g., Notepad) works correctly.

*Root Cause:*
GitHub Copilot’s clipboard implementation adds metadata/formatting to copied text. This behavior is controlled entirely by Copilot and cannot be modified externally.

*Resolution:*
This issue *cannot be fixed on our end* because:

* Clipboard behavior is controlled by the source application (Copilot), not our system.
* Browser/OS security restrictions prevent intercepting or sanitizing clipboard data pre-paste.

*Workarounds:*

# Manually type the email address.
# Copy from a plain-text source (e.g., Notepad) first.

*Final Note:*
*Technically impossible to fix* — this is a limitation imposed by third-party clipboard handling.

column1: Delete Option Enabled for ZIP Upload Before Contract Extraction and Status Update
column31:
*Summary* 

The delete option for ZIP uploads is currently active even if the contracts within the ZIP file have not been fully extracted and their statuses updated to 'Pending for Approval.' This creates a potential risk of accidental deletion of essential contract data before processing is complete.



*Steps To Replicate*

# Upload a Zip file
# Observe the delete option available for the ZIP file prior to extracting all contracts and updating their statuses.
# Attempt to delete the ZIP file.



*Expected Result:* 

The delete option should remain disabled for ZIP uploads until:

All contracts within the ZIP file are fully extracted

The statuses of the extracted contracts are updated to 'Pending for Approval.'

*Actual Result*

The delete option is enabled, allowing the ZIP file to be deleted even if contract extraction and status update are incomplete.



*Screenshots*

column1: Decimal Precision and Validation Issues in Annual Contract Value and Calendar Dates
column31:
*Summary* 

The application is experiencing multiple issues related to decimal precision, date validations, and display logic for Annual Contract Value and Cost Per Unit fields.

*Issues Identified*:



# Decimal places for *Annual Contract Value* and *Cost Per Unit* are not restricted to two decimal points.
# Calendar *start and end date validation* is missing, allowing users to select dates beyond the end date.
# *"N/A" is not displayed* in the  Cost Per Unit fields when the Annual Value is zero.
# After updating a contract with zero Annual Value if user edit the contract again and update it , a validation error will display on the Annual value field.



*Steps to Reproduce*:



# Open a Contract from the Existing Contracts page
# Enter values with more than 2 decimal points in Annual Contract Value or Cost Per Unit fields.
# Choose a calendar start date and set an end date. Attempt to select dates beyond the specified end date.
# Enter "0" as the Annual Value and observe the Annual and Cost Per Unit fields.
# After saving it , open the contract again and click Confirm
# Observe the validation error



*Expected Behavior*:



# Decimal precision in Annual Contract Value and Cost Per Unit should be restricted to *2 decimal points*.
# Calendar should enforce *validation*, disabling dates after the selected end date.
# Fields for Annual and Cost Per Unit should display *"N/A"* when the Annual Value is zero.
# Validation error should be handled.



*Actual Behavior*:



# Users can enter more than two decimal points in the specified fields.
# Dates beyond the end date are not disabled, leading to potential input errors.
# "N/A" is not displayed when the Annual Value is zero.
# Validation error displayed

Contract Management

column31:
*Acceptance criteria*

_When connexus user logsin_

* user should able to upload the base scope of work and should display in base scope of work library
* The modal should open when the user clicks *Create > Base Scope Library* from the dropdown.
* The modal should be *centered* on the screen with a blurred background.
* Users should be able to *close the modal* using:
** The *"X" button* on the top right.
** The *Cancel button* at the bottom.

h4. *2. Modal Structure & Fields*

* The modal title should be *"Upload Base Scope Of Work"*.
* It should contain the following *form fields*:
*# *Scope Of Work Name (Text Input)*
*#* Placeholder text: *"Enter Scope Of Work Name"*.
*#* Input should be *mandatory* before uploading.
*#* SOW name field should be autopopulated with the predefine name : name should be in the format : <Selected Service>- <Created Date><Unique identifying name>
*# *Service (Dropdown)*
*#* Placeholder text: *"Select services"*.
*#* Users should be able to choose from a predefined list of services.
*#* This should include both services and subservices 
*#* this field should be a single select
*# *Upload Scope Of Work (File Upload)*
*#* Users can either *click to upload* or *drag and drop* files.
*#* Allowed file formats: *PDF (need to be confrimed by basim)*
*#* An error message should be displayed if an unsupported format or an oversized file is uploaded.

h4. *3. Action Buttons*

* *Cancel Button*
** Clicking *Cancel* should close the modal without saving changes.
* *Upload Button*
** The *Upload button* should remain *disabled* until all mandatory fields are filled.
** Once clicked, the file should be validated and uploaded to the system.
** Upon successful upload, the modal should *close automatically* and display a loading message modal
** Modal should show the message : *Extracting Base Scope of Work...* sub text as : *Please wait while we extract the Base Scope of Work. This may take a few moments..*
** In case of an error, an appropriate *error message* should be shown (e.g., "File upload failed. Please try again.").
**_View Mode_*
** Once the system extracts the file it should open the extracted scope of work in view form. 
** user should able to close the file by clicking on close button 
** user should able to view the file from list page by clicking on view scope of work option
** download  & view updated history option should be avialable in view mode

** User should able to download the SOW file in pdf ,doc format
** View updated history button should be availablle in hte view page. 
** On click on the view updated history button it should open theversion history and should show the previous files with the user and date and time. 
** User should able to view the file. File will not be color coded. it will display only the last uploaded or updated file
** View mode should have a download option to download the file
** *_Edit Sow File:_* User should able to edit the file by clicking on edit icon and it will open in edit format 
** Editor should be open when user clicks on edit it. 
** update and cancel button should be available when user opens the scope of work in edit form
** User should able to edit the form and click on update button 
** cancel should cancel the update and redirect to the view page of SOW file 
** if two users update the same file,last updated user file will be overwrite the currrent file. 
** After updating the file it should redirect to the view page
* *SOW Edit Mode*
** user should able to click on edit from the list page 
** User should able to reupload the file in the same sow. 
** once the user clicks on edit button, it should open the create modal in Edit mode and should able to reupload the file after deleting the current file 
** TItle should be “Edit base scope Library“
** Service and Scope of work name should be enabled and user should able to change the name and service from the dialog box . 
** User should able to remove the current file and reupload the file from the system 
** user shuold able to cancel the reupload and it should not update the file.
* *Deactivate* 
** User should able to deactivate the scope of work from the list page. 
** deactivate confirmation message should be displayed when user clicks on deactivate option 
** once the user clicks on deactivate it should change the color to red and should able to activate again once the user clicks on active button again

column1: AI Fetches Duplicate Services for Each Property in Contract
column31:
*Summary* 

When processing a contract (Republic Services), the AI erroneously fetches multiple duplicate service entries for each property. For example, the service *"Trash"* is listed multiple times instead of appearing once per property.



*Steps To Replicate*

# Make sure service name is already exist in the application
# Upload a contract (Republic Services - [^Republic Services - RMS 2017 (1).pdf] ).
# Wait until the contract is in *Pending for Approval* status.
# Open the contract and complete the approval process.
# Navigate to *Existing Contracts* .
# Observe that multiple instances of the same service (e.g., "Trash, Trash") are fetched instead of a single entry per property.

*Expected Result:* 

Each property under the contract should list only *one instance* of each relevant service (e.g., *Trash* should appear *once* per property).

*Actual Result*

The AI fetches *multiple duplicate instances* of the same service for each property under the contract (e.g., "Trash, Trash").

[~accountid:62146cb42d057500723ebae2] 

*Proposed Solution:*

* *Modify AI fetching logic* to ensure services are listed *only once* per property.
* Implement a *deduplication mechanism* to filter out redundant service entries before displaying contract details.
* Ensure *backend validation* prevents duplicate services from being stored in the contract database.

*Troubleshooting Steps:*

* Verify if the issue occurs across *all contracts* or only specific ones (e.g., Republic Services).
* Check AI data extraction logic to confirm if the duplication occurs *at the retrieval* or *storage stage*.
* Review contract processing logs to determine whether multiple instances are being *pulled* from the source data or incorrectly generated.
